attributes.detail: `Package Version`, `Version Alias` (layer 01) and `Bundle Manifest` (layer 06) are all Missing, so consumers cannot pin a block version. Packaging (stage 3) either waits on them or ships unversioned — undecided (boxel-catalog/docs/bottom-up-block-strategy.md §7.3).

cardInfo.name: Stage 3 has no version-pinning story
cardInfo.summary: Version-pinning blocks packaging; decision open in strategy §7.3
